text.en: Chef Leandro “Doy” Sto. Domingo opened his restaurant.
He trained at Pan Pacific Hotel Manila under Chef Sau del Rosario.
He served as Avenue Plaza Hotel’s first executive chef before opening his own restaurant.
His Bicolano fusion dishes include Laing Embutido and Cheesy Bicol Express.
